plans.description: Prevent lost edits. Update only the exact revision originally downloaded by this editor; require a matching saved strong ETag.
Publish a brand new resource only. Refuse to replace any existing document at the destination, even an identical version.
Refresh an existing resource regardless of its revision. Require destination existence but allow replacing any current version.

records.context: Refresh an existing resource regardless of its revision. Require destination existence but allow replacing any current version.

checks.reason: A current representation exists: existence-only precondition passes regardless of version.
checks.notice: Independent PUT snapshot check only. Passing is not a server success prediction; authentication, other conditions and later changes are not modeled.
